What we do

Technology that helps businesses run and grow

OneClicq is a software development company based in Greater Noida. We design, build and support the systems growing businesses rely on, working as one team from first idea to long-term support.

  1. 01

    Build

    Custom software, web applications and mobile apps designed around how your business works.

  2. 02

    Connect

    APIs, payment gateways and e-commerce platforms that link your systems, partners and customers.

  3. 03

    Intelligence & cloud

    AI, automation, analytics and cloud infrastructure that make operations faster and more scalable.

  4. 04

    Run

    Maintenance, monitoring and support that keep software secure and reliable after launch.

Who we are

Our mission and vision

Mission

To help businesses turn ideas into scalable, intelligent products, removing the friction between vision and working technology.

Vision

A world where every organisation, whatever its size, can access enterprise-grade engineering and AI to compete and grow.

Our values

How we work with clients and each other

  1. 01

    Craft

    We care about the details others skip, because quality compounds over time.

  2. 02

    Ownership

    We act as partners with a stake in your outcomes, not just suppliers.

  3. 03

    Curiosity

    We keep learning new tools and methods so you benefit from them.

  4. 04

    Clarity

    Plain language, honest trade-offs and no black boxes.

How we work with clients

A partnership, not a hand-off

  • The people you meet build your product

    You work directly with the engineers and designers on your project, without layers in between.

  • Transparent from day one

    Clear scope, regular demos and honest trade-offs, so there are no surprises.

  • You're never locked in

    We use mainstream technology and document our work, so your software stays yours to run and grow.

  • We stay after launch

    Support, maintenance and improvements continue with the same team that built the system.

  • Local office, remote-friendly

    We're based in Greater Noida West and work with clients across India through regular video calls and in-person meetings where practical.

Our story

Milestones so far

  1. 2021

    Founded on a simple idea

    OneClicq starts with a small team and a conviction: great engineering should be accessible, not exclusive.

  2. 2022

    First enterprise clients

    We deliver production platforms in finance and retail, and referrals begin.

  3. 2024

    AI practice launches

    A dedicated AI team starts building agents, generative AI and predictive analytics into real products.

  4. 2026

    50+ projects across 10+ industries

    A multi-disciplinary team working with clients across India, and still growing.
